forms.plain_english: The definitive proxy statement sent to shareholders before the annual meeting. It holds director nominees, board independence and tenure, the executive compensation tables (Summary Compensation Table, pay ratio, pay versus performance), auditor fees, management and shareholder proposals with the board's voting recommendation.
forms.who_files_when: Issuer, annually, at least 120 days-style practice before the meeting; legal rule: file definitive copy no later than the date first sent to holders, and within 120 days of fiscal year end if Part III is incorporated into the 10-K. Filing dates vary by company: Apple early January, Berkshire mid-March, Amazon early April, Netflix mid-April, Alphabet late April, Microsoft late October.

products.name: Executive compensation dataset (SCT + PvP + pay ratio)

forms.plain_english: Notice of exempt solicitation by a non-management party (usually an investor or advocacy group) who is urging shareholders how to vote without asking for proxy authority. Filed publicly, often with a full campaign letter.
forms.who_files_when: Shareholder or advocacy group holding over $5 million in shares, no later than 3 days after first sending the materials to holders; peak in April-May before meetings.
